title: relative-angle RoPE after moving requantization before rotation
disposition: literal unchanged-D route refuted in parent/reviewer oracle preflight; changed-D variant deferred
reason: Integer rotate-then-round does not commute with pre-rounding, even at equal positions where the real relative rotation is identity. Existing IDEA0032 is a distinct current RoPE range/certificate route, not permission to move rounding. Parent/reviewer reports C=8852,S=13787 at frequency0/position1, accumulator pair(2,0), rq15 output(1,1) and original score2, versus pre-rq1(1,0) and relative-angle0 score1. Saved primary artifact: research/ideas/results/seed-preflight-2026-10-19.json, exact small oracle control executed by independent reviewer; this author did not execute it. Not a finite-domain exhaustion or full-protocol theorem. A changed-D variant needs its own explicit fidelity/range and rounding specification.

title: public-budget top-B block attention with strict ranking/routing
disposition: deferred by max_ideas=2; distinct seed retained
reason: Public budget alone does not make the private selected blocks public or ZK. Exact ranking/tie rule, selected-set nonemptiness, full layer/KV-head/dimension routing, public-policy binding, output fidelity and selector/layout costs are missing. EXP0016 warns that balanced merged-instance unions can pass local checks. Static seed33 removes ranking/routing complexity for the first bounded note, not this distinct dynamic seed.

title: exact-zero tile skipping via GQA/frequency-split integer ball bounds
reason: It can preserve D only if every skipped Exp value is proved exactly zero under the actual table/rounding and every bound operand is a true integer with a no-wrap bound. The certificate must bind each layer/KV-head/block and frequency group; GQA sharing cannot erase query-specific bounds. Public kept-tile budgets still need oblivious/padded routing and a joint simulator. Hard-zero fraction at current sigma and complete certificate/lookup/mask overhead are unmeasured. No old 42-74% estimate credited.

title: public static attention shapes
reason: Distinct public-shape mechanism eliminates secret ranking/compaction, has an exact mathematical statement and a cheap selector/layout falsification path. It changes D, requires policy binding and uniform-template handling, and earns zero cost/fidelity credit until those are derived.

title: round-batched streamed windows with unchanged messages
disposition: no new ID: overlaps existing IDEA0017; deferred through that note
reason: IDEA0017 already owns multi-round grid bookkeeping and its current-spec/overflow preflight; IDEA0022/EXP0012 test the resident integer/product window subset. Those measurements do not test complete streamed lookup leaves or a new 65536-cadence implementation. Width/cadence bounds and field-valued masks prevent inheriting integer-only gains. A new title is not a new mechanism.
evidence: IDEA0017 current Grid bounds and leaf completeness

title: zero-knowledge Hobbit tile fold
disposition: deferred by max_ideas=2; not a duplicate of selected level2
reason: Tile folding changes streamed leaf relations, adds cross terms and requires a conditional one-time-pad/simulator argument. Current RFC0032 already resolves pair-bit/tree masking design; it does not prove a new Hobbit fold or its full joint view. No complete binding/extractor/mask construction is in this bounded unit. Old streaming percentages are stale and conditional; unknown security gives no gain credit.

title: stage-input checkpoints to replace GEMM-shaped regeneration
disposition: deferred by max_ideas=2; requires measured/derived marginal schedule
reason: RFC0018 already caches layer boundaries and fuses passes whose points are known. A distinct extra cache must identify which additional GEMM-shaped inputs survive across actual stages, public lifetime/recompute plan, capacity, clearing and marginal P3 reduction. New independent stage derivation enables inspection but does not supply timing or a full GPU pass planner. Not credited as free regen removal or new commitment-independent saving.

title: second Ligero level over combined opening rows
reason: Distinct transmission/compression mechanism, addresses structural proof-size/verifier deficit and works on materialized opening rows. It preserves original column multiproofs and explicitly links original evaluation/column equations through a sumcheck and final level2 opening. Current groups/allocated rows, coefficient-basis dependency, extractor/FS budget and joint ZK remain unknown, so zero gain credited.

title: wider advice rows over committed combined rows
disposition: deferred by max_ideas=2; conditional follow-up to seed37
reason: Only opened-column bytes shrink when nonzero row count shrinks; wider rows can enlarge NTT traffic, buffers and change R/nu/mask rate. With no level2 compression, larger combined rows can offset savings. New current layout/group counts and exact error budgets must precede a size/performance claim; old 0.63GB projection not reused.

title: rate1/8 persistent weight commitment under Johnson regime
disposition: deferred by max_ideas=2; not covered by advice-rate refutation alone
reason: EXP0004 advice-cost refutation is not a direct weight refutation because weight commitment is amortized, but original weight column answers, storage/epoch/link budgets and Johnson extraction/version obligations must be rederived. W=0.24 GPU-s is only one model term and cannot price complete epoch or proof bytes. Current full weight/hiding implementation and draft RFC0021 are not approved evidence for a new parameter set.
